title: Bloodline Truth
next_chapter_hook: The deepening awakening of the ancient will threatened Chen Ji's soul with division—he had to make a choice within three breaths, or he would lose himself forever.

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes to find himself in a chaotic void—without sky or earth, only endless starlight drifting like fireflies. He looked down at his hands, where fingertips flowed a pale golden bloodline light that intertwined with the Tianji Record Fragment beneath his feet.

"So this is... the inner world of the Tianji Record?" he murmured, his voice echoing layer upon layer through the void. In the distance, a massive Wheel of Reincarnation slowly turned, covered in dense ancient inscriptions, each telling of a forgotten truth.

dialogue.content:
"You've finally arrived." An aged voice rang from the void, as Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly took form. He gazed at Chen Ji, his eyes flickering with complex emotions. "A thousand years... the seventh Chess Player has finally appeared again."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, alarm bells ringing in his heart: "The seventh Chess Player? What do you mean? What connection do I have with this Chess Player you speak of?"

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng waved his hand, and the Wheel of Reincarnation in the void suddenly enlarged. The ancient inscriptions squirmed like living things, weaving a blurry image in the air—a man bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, standing solemnly before the Tianji Record, sealing it.

"This is your ancestor," Mo Xiansheng's voice carried an indescribable vicissitude. "Chen Tianming, the last Watcher before the collapse of the Ancient Celestial Realm, and also the seventh Chess Player."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's breath suddenly caught. The bloodline light at his fingertips blazed intensely, as if responding to that name. Countless fragments flashed through his mind like lightning—their father's deathbed instructions, his mother's mysterious origins, and the Chen family genealogical record that had never explained its own origin.

"Chen Tianming..." he whispered the name, his voice slightly trembling. "What was his relationship to me?"

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's form suddenly split in two. Another more majestic and ancient figure emerged from within him, completely matching the ancient being Chen Ji had seen countless times in dreams. Seven strands of fate wrapped around him, each connecting to the rise and fall of an era.

"It's far more than relationship." Mo Xiansheng shook his head with a bitter smile. "You are his reincarnation. Or rather—the last remnant of his will sealed within you is awakening."

dialogue.content:
Just then, a familiar voice suddenly echoed in the void—it was Chen Nian, his missing sister! Chen Ji turned sharply, only to see a girl's figure appear on the Wheel of Reincarnation in the distance. She was bound by countless chains, eyes full of tears.

"Brother... save me..." her voice was mournful. "They're going to use me to open... that door..."

text.content:
Chen Ji's whole body trembled violently. An unprecedented fury and heartache surged through him. He stepped forward abruptly, wanting to rush toward his sister's figure, but was stopped by Mo Xiansheng.

"That's an illusion!" Mo Xiansheng shouted sternly. "The Holy Sect created this illusion using her bloodline as the guide, aiming to lure you into their trap! But this also proves—she is indeed alive, and held captive by the Holy Sect!"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji abruptly stopped, fists clenched so tightly his fingernails embedded deep into his palms. His gaze instantly shifted from anxiety to coldness—that belonged to his past life, the ruthless calculation of the seventh Chess Player.

"Very well," he said quietly, a dangerous curve appearing at the corner of his mouth. "The Holy Sect, using my sister as bait? Seems you've all grown tired of living."

Mo Xiansheng observed the change in his eyes and nodded with satisfaction: "Chen Tianming's cold-blooded nature... you've finally awakened."

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng revealed the complete truth of the Chen family's bloodline: A thousand years ago, Chen Tianming transformed himself into the artifact spirit of the Tianji Record to prevent the celestial realm's collapse. The cost was that with each reincarnation, the ancient will would gradually awaken. Now that the ancient will within Chen Ji had awakened by thirty percent, he had to make a choice...

choices.description: Completely awaken the seventh Chess Player's will within, merge with the ancient ancestor, and gain complete past-life memories and power.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Chen Tianming's complete combat experience and strategy
choices.risk_hint: May lose complete control over the body

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, letting the bloodline dormant for a thousand years within him completely surge. Pale golden light burst from every acupoint on his body, converging into a towering phantom—the very image of the ancient Watcher Chen Tianming. The two consciousnesses collided violently in the depths of his soul, countless past-life scenes flickering past like a carousel.

dialogue.content:
"A thousand years," Chen Ji spoke, but his voice carried a dual echo. "I've finally returned."

His eyes transformed—one into a brilliant golden pupil while the other remained its original deep black—the two wills were fighting for control of this body.

choices.description: Forcefully suppress the awakened ancient will within, retain complete self-consciousness, but the bloodline power will be difficult to fully utilize.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain self-control, can use partial bloodline abilities
choices.risk_hint: Ancient will may lose control at critical moments

text.content: Chen Ji coldly snorted. His soul transformed into a majestic mountain peak, ruthlessly suppressing the awakened ancient will. The golden light was forcibly restrained in its struggle, eventually retreating into the depths of the bloodline.

dialogue.content:
"Since you chose to sleep, don't expect to wake so easily." His voice was ice-cold and firm. "This body will be controlled by me."

In the distance, Chen Nian's figure on the Wheel of Reincarnation gradually faded and disappeared, but Chen Ji knew—this proved she was indeed still alive, being closely monitored by the Holy Sect.

choices.description: Negotiate with the ancient will as an equal, establish a symbiotic relationship, with both consciousnesses coexisting in the same body.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming large amounts of Heavenly Fate Value to maintain balance
choices.visible_reward: Simultaneously possesses human emotions and ancient wisdom
choices.risk_hint: Extremely difficult to maintain balance, any slight negligence may cause soul collapse

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, facing the towering ancient will with his soul body. He felt no fear, no subservience, but calmly extended his hand.

dialogue.content:
"You are Chen Tianming, and I am Chen Ji." He stared directly into those eyes containing the mysteries of heaven and earth. "We are both Chen family bloodline—there is no need to distinguish between you and me. You give me your wisdom and power, and I give you the chance to see this world anew."

The ancient will fell silent for a moment, then let out an aged laugh.

text.content:
The ancient will's phantom trembled slightly, as if examining this descendant who dared to treat his ancestor as an equal. After a moment, it slowly extended its hand, touching Chen Ji's palm. In an instant, a brilliant golden light burst forth from both their palms, illuminating the entire void as bright as daylight.

"Interesting." The aged voice carried a hint of praise. "In a thousand years, the first descendant to dare look me in the eye like this. Very well, I agree to coexist with you—but remember, if you die, I too shall completely dissipate."

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng watched this scene, a flicker of emotion crossing his eyes: "Elder Chen Tianming... you've finally found a worthy descendant to entrust."

The ancient will transformed into a stream of light that entered Chen Ji's brow center, slowly merging with his soul. Countless images flooded into Chen Ji's mind—memories of the ancient celestial realm's final moments, the seventh Chess Player facing the Eye of Heavenly Dao alone with desperation and defiance.

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, finding himself still standing where he was, but the bloodline light around him had completely changed—it was no longer simple pale gold, but a brilliant interweaving of deep purple and golden yellow like the Milky Way. He could clearly feel two types of power surging within him: one belonging to human warmth and emotion, the other belonging to the ancient Watcher's wisdom and majesty.

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded: "The bloodline truth has been revealed—your Chen family bloodline indeed originates from the ancient celestial realm's Watcher lineage. But now—" his tone suddenly grew grave, "I sense abnormal movements outside. Someone seems to be trying to forcibly break through the Tianji Record's seal!"

choice.prompt: Violent vibrations came from outside the Tianji Record. Chen Ji had to make an immediate decision—someone was tracking his bloodline aura, intending to capture him before his awakening stabilized. He sensed the cultivators' auras—there appeared to be two familiar figures...

choices.description: Use the newly awakened bloodline power to directly defeat the intruders, demonstrating strength and deterring secretly watching forces.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the degree of bloodline awakening
choices.visible_reward: Enhance reputation, may subjugate or severely injure enemies
choices.risk_hint: May attract even more powerful enemies

text.content: Chen Ji coldly snorted, his divine sense instantly piercing through the Tianji Record's barrier to perceive the outside situation. There were three cultivators in total—two auras he knew extremely well. One was Su Qingyao's cold sword intent, and the other was actually Ye Qing's demonic path mist!

dialogue.content:
"Interesting," a slight smile appeared at the corner of his mouth. "The Tianqing Sect's righteous path senior fellow and the demonic path saintess actually came together. It seems my 'trash' persona can no longer fool them."

He waved his hand, and the Tianji Record's barrier suddenly dispersed. Golden and purple interweaving bloodline light shot skyward, dyeing the entire night sky into a spectacular aurora. "Since you've all come, stop hiding—come out."

choices.description: Converge bloodline aura, continue presenting as the trash persona, secretly observe the visitors' true intentions.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity for proactive attack
choices.visible_reward: Clearly see various factions' hidden cards
choices.risk_hint: May expose a false appearance of being no match

text.content: Chen Ji's thoughts shifted. He decided to continue hiding his true strength. He completely converged his bloodline power, returning to that weak废物杂役弟子 appearance with a faint aura, even deliberately making his complexion paler.

dialogue.content:
He weakly coughed twice and quietly spoke to the void: "两位... Two of you... coming so late at night, I wonder what brings you here? If you've come to see Chen's jokes, I'm afraid you'll be disappointed—this废物 has nothing worth seeing."

His tone was utterly humble, but deep within his eyes flickered a cold light.

text.content:
The Tianji Record's barrier completely shattered, night wind carrying a bloody scent rushing in. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes. Through the super perception granted by bloodline awakening, he clearly 'saw' the trajectories of two figures in the night sky—Su Qingyao in her blue dress as cold and pure as the moon emerging from dust, her sword intent sharp; Ye Qing walked on诡异的魔雾脸上带着意味深长的笑意。

两道目光在空中交汇，一冷一邪，却都直直地锁定了陈机。墨先生的警告还在耳边回响："她们不是敌人，但也绝非朋友——小心。"
